text:
maria: Quick triage thread for Turnstile14b int4 canary. Observed: P95 latency +30% vs fp16 at our defaults and 2 coldstart OOMs within first 200 requests. Posting config and logs.
ken: Hosted canary or dedicated?
maria: Hosted canary. Config snapshot:```json {"batch_size":16, "max_new_tokens":256, "prefetch":true, "kv_eviction":"auto", "quantize":"int4-calibrated"} ```
maria: Error lines: `slab_alloc_fail at slot=43, free_slots=0` then worker restart; also `scratch_buf_alloc peak=1.4GB` on kernel=v2-matmul-int4.
ravi: Sounds like memory fragmentation + a kernel path allocating big scratch. Two quick experiments: reduce batch_size to 8 and enable slot_reserve=0.15; and try forcing kernel=v1 which avoids that scratch path. Also consider lowering max_new_tokens default to 128 for this model archetype.
aaron: Agree. Also check calibration mode; per_channel quant can sometimes induce distribution shifts for some attention heads leading to quality dips.
maria: Running experiment: batch_size=8, max_new_tokens=128, slot_reserve=0.15, kernel=v1. Smoke (1k requests) running now.
maria (20m): Smoke results: no OOMs, p95 latency improved vs earlier canary but still ~+12% vs fp16. Throughput down as expected. Noted a small quality regression on summarization eval: -1.8 ROUGE-L.
ravi: What calibration params? per_channel? hessian?
maria: calibrate=true, per_channel=true, hessian_scale=false. I'll flip per_channel=false and re-run eval.
aaron: If regression persists >1% we should route heavy summarization prompts to fp16 variant via rollout guard. Also try slight increase to soft_reserve for prefix KV to help long prompts.
ken: We should gate canary rollouts: auto-hold if >10% latency regression or >1% quality regression. Can infra add a telemetry guard and tag the canary? @infra-bot
infra-bot: Canary created 14850004300: 5% traffic -> turnstile14b-int4 (batch=8, max_new_tokens=128). Telemetry hooks added: latency_threshold=10%, quality_threshold=1%. Alerts wired to #eng-ml.
maria: I'll run full eval suites (summarization, long-context, conv) and post results + recommended model defaults PR. Current recommended defaults draft: batch_size=8, max_new_tokens=128, slot_reserve=0.15, fallback_route=fp16 for flagged prompts, quant_calibration=per_layer (no per_channel).
aaron: If per_layer recovers >0.5% quality we can keep int4. Otherwise plan B: keep int4 but enable dynamic routing for long/complex prompts and keep fp16 behind route.
ken: Also add in model-metadata the kernel pinning note and the calibration method so Dedicated/on-prem deployments can inherit safe defaults.
maria: Will do. Posting full eval in ~2h and tagging this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
